scope: POSIX host identity-observation receipt failure custody, sanitized configured-context/actor observations, atomic current-attempt publication and stale-result invalidation. Entire independent execution uses synthetic responses or an owned fake CLI in temporary repositories.
disposition: No remaining blocker in this observation-only scope. Two independently reproduced integrity findings were fixed and tested against final source.

resolvedFindings.issue: An older overlapping success could overwrite a newer canonical authentication-failure receipt. The older callback already had its last actor reply, started and completed a newer failing attempt, then published its older success unconditionally.
resolvedFindings.fix: A stable sidecar flock serializes pending claims and final compare-and-replace. Final publication requires the exact current attemptId and observation-pending status under that same lock. Superseded attempts return exit2 with unknown counts and do not replace the current receipt. The lock inode remains in place.
resolvedFindings.verification: The newer failed and newer pending attempt are each protected; a terminal attempt cannot publish twice. An independently controlled thread interleaving pauses between comparison and rename and detects removal of flock. The repository actual two-process overlap test was also independently rerun.

resolvedFindings.issue: urlsplit normalizes newline/TAB and accepts other malformed host text. The helper retained raw host strings containing newline, TAB, NUL or space as configured contexts.
resolvedFindings.fix: Reject non-ASCII/control/whitespace before parsing; retain only the bounded HTTPS host form with DNS-label validation and existing port/userinfo/path/query/fragment guards.
resolvedFindings.verification: All four original malformed-host witnesses refuse without raw marker retention. Separate valid-host letters interrupted by newline/TAB isolate the parser-normalization gap; removing only the pre-parse guard admits them and is detected.

sourceAssessment.attemptLifecycle: Before any CLI invocation, a fresh pending receipt with a new UUID, empty observations and unknown counts replaces prior observations atomically. Pending write failure prevents CLI execution. Auth/parsing/context errors retain sanitized partial observations with unknown counts; a hard process exit leaves the new pending state instead of older success. Failed final write cannot print successful completion.
sourceAssessment.publication: Claim and conditional terminal publication hold the same stable sidecar flock. A stale or already-terminal attempt cannot publish again. Temporary files share the destination directory; file flush/fsync and atomic rename prevent partial JSON publication. The output is anchored to the helper source root, so a different cwd does not redirect canonical invalidation.
sourceAssessment.redaction: CLI exception arguments, raw stdout/stderr authentication diagnostics, unknown metadata, userName and injected secret fields are not retained. Errors use bounded known codes and selected stage/profile names. Version, context and actor values are explicitly shape/bound checked. Failure/partial state is not represented as zero available identities.
sourceAssessment.identityMeaning: Success observes at least two distinct active non-installer actor IDs within the same configured host/account/workspace context. Aliases collapse by actor ID, and mismatched configured contexts cannot create readiness. This does not verify ordinary-role eligibility, grants, server/SQL context, namespaces, compute or native authority. authority and complete remain false.
sourceAssessment.resourceScope: The native stdout cap is checked after subprocess capture; this is not a total preallocation/CPU/output-stream bound. CLI timeout is30seconds. Selected source before/after hashes identify endpoints but do not prove an immutable execution interval or hermetic Python/CLI environment.
sourceAssessment.testSafety: Owned fake CLI binaries and cloned helper paths are used for process termination and overlap. Review did not invoke the real databricks auth/current-user CLI, network, SDK, cloud writes or canonical root actor receipt.

syntheticControls.coverage: Successful observation without authority; alias/context mismatch; every failure stage and partial count; pending-before-CLI hard exit; pending/final write errors; secret redaction; malformed native actor/context; CLI timeout/unavailability/output cap; helper source drift; distinct attempt identity; newer failed/pending receipt precedence; terminal one-shot publication; controlled comparison/rename interleaving.

repositoryTests.includes: Actual owned process group termination with different cwd and copied helper; two overlapping processes using fake CLI only; exact newer-failure preservation. Initial17test result retained separately as historical source stage.

sourceMutations.note: The pending-publication omission also causes four incidental missing-artifact/attempt-key errors in other controls. These are retained transparently and excluded from detection;28 explicit semantic expectation failures independently detect that weakening. All other variants are detected without harness errors.

qualificationLimits: This qualifies cooperative POSIX process interruption, atomic replacement and flock/current-attempt publication. It does not claim power-loss durability, directory-fsync persistence, hostile filesystem/sidecar replacement resistance, UUID-collision or general ABA immunity.

Configured context metadata is not independently verified server/SQL context. Distinct identity observations are not ordinary-role eligibility, grants, authentication provenance for downstream operations or native backend qualification.

The parent live preflight is separate, parent-owned and not independently executed or pinned here. The review never reads credentials or uses a real cloud identity. Synthetic IDs/hosts and marker strings in retained fixtures are invented.
Superseded attempts cannot overwrite current state; their canonical observations are intentionally not a separate immutable audit history.
No src/spec/package/lock or158case-definition change relative to basec68736f3. No full native gate or library rebuild was rerun by reviewer, and no acceptance case is promoted.

Parent independently corrected cwd-dependent output routing before final capture; the final cloned-helper different-cwd process test is included. This routing correction was not claimed as an independently discovered finding.
